_comment: Damage reflection, design step 2 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 10). Mogg Maniac +
Boros Reckoner + four opponent Spirits = 6 creatures, so Blasphemous Act ({8}{R}, {1} less per
creature on the battlefield, BOTH sides) costs {2}{R} off three lands. It deals 13 to each
creature as ONE damage event: everything dies, and both reflections still resolve through
last-known information -- the Maniac's to the opponent, the Reckoner's 'any target' to the
opponent (our own face folded away, F1; no creature is left) -- 13 + 13 = 26 >= 20. Without the
Act the two attack for 4 a turn, so a T4 win needs both the discount and both triggers.
